g.title: SAL_QSP_Model
g.text: The disease is graded by a number the assay reports — TOTAL plasma salicylate — that is separated from the quantity which does the killing (salicylate inside brain cells)
by two multiplications nobody measures: the free fraction (albumin saturates) and the pH partition of a weak acid, pKa 3.0. Brain intracellular pH is BUFFERED and plasma pH is not,
so every intervention that moves PaCO2 or bicarbonate moves the partition — which is why the ventilator is a drug, and why the lab number can improve while the patient is being poisoned.
